statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail), and r is a positive integer that is the smallest positive integer d such that S(d) <= threshold, where S(d) = sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} ceil(nums[i] / d) and ceil(x / d) denotes the smallest integer greater than or equal to the real quotient x / d.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit integers and threshold is a 64-bit integer such that 1 <= len(nums) <= 50,000, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1,000,000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), and len(nums) <= threshold <= 1,000,000.
